processing_method: Unchanged exact numeric max_voltage line filter in 70000/150000/275000/500000 V; unchanged transmission-tagged primary polygons and three review predicates. Conflicting flags quarantined. Existing line/polygon exports retain seven coordinate decimals and RFC7946 winding, without simplification/dissolve. WGS84 geodesic line lengths. All raw substation points matched against all polygons under the versioned policy; eligible distinct candidates retain original point coordinates and unknown voltage. Polygon point_on_surface symbols preserve parent IDs and do not count as inventory.

definitions.matched: One supported source correspondence within 100 m, with distinctive name/reference evidence and no attribute conflict. Not an authoritative duplicate certification.
definitions.uncertain: Intersection, proximity within 500 m, numeric-ID evidence, or a distinctive name/reference association within 1 km without one unambiguous supported match.
definitions.distinct_point_only_candidate: No plausible polygon correspondence under this policy. Distinct is relative to this export and these thresholds, not verified physical-station identity or transmission function.

substation_matching_policy.identifier_policy: Preserve original id and sign. Numeric IDs compared across layers; absent OSM element-kind fields prevent treating equal numeric IDs as confirmed shared OSM identity.
substation_matching_policy.name_policy: Case/accent/punctuation normalization; strip generic utility/station words and explicit kV text; retain site-code numbers (PK 276 differs from PK 277). Distinctive token-set equality only; no fuzzy substring or arbitrary place-name inference.
substation_matching_policy.eligibility_policy: Only distinct candidates; missing voltage stays null. Hold known distribution/minor_distribution/generation/other non-transmission roles, non-target known numeric voltage, conflicting status flags, and office/park function clues outside the map layer for manual review. These holds do not delete source records.
substation_matching_policy.distance_method: Per-point WGS84 azimuthal equidistant projection against every raw polygon; projected stored-edge chord approximation in meters. Intersection uses original EPSG:4326 geometry. Thresholds are QA rules, not surveyed boundaries or network connectivity.

database_license_notice: The processed derivative database and presentation symbols are available under ODbL 1.0. Retain attribution and license notices on redistribution.

fields.feature_id: Unique original inventory/review record <source_layer>:<original id>; negative IDs preserved. A derived display symbol reuses its parent ID and is not another record.
fields.source_id: Original id as a string, never GeoPackage fid. OSM element kind is not verified.
fields.asset_type: transmission_line, substation_polygon, or separately reviewed substation_point.
fields.display_name: Original nonblank name, otherwise interface fallback, not an official name.
fields.display_name_is_fallback: True when display_name is a synthetic interface label.
fields.name: Original name or null.
fields.max_voltage_v: Numeric original max_voltage in volts; null if unavailable.
fields.max_voltage_kv: max_voltage_v / 1000, only for finite positive numeric values.
fields.voltages_raw: Unchanged source voltages string, including empty or multi-value strings.
fields.all_voltages_kv: Unique valid numeric semicolon tokens / 1000; never used to widen selection.
fields.disused: Original line flag; null for polygon layers where field is absent.
fields.source_status_verified: Always false. Source flags do not verify operation.
fields.substation_type: Original polygon tag, never coerced to transmission.
fields.review_reason: One of three disjoint candidate reasons; null for primary features.
fields.location: Original line location; null for substations. Does not establish HVDC.
fields.circuits: Original line circuit count when known; no assumption of one circuit.
fields.mapped_geometry_length_km: WGS84 geodesic line geometry length, not official circuit-km.
fields.geometry_role: original_point for point-only candidates; derived_polygon_representative_point for display symbols, which do not count as inventory.
fields.matching_classification: Point-only publication requires distinct_point_only_candidate under the versioned QA policy; not verified physical-station identity.
fields.matching_reason: Explanation of the source matching decision; no voltage or function is inherited from polygons.
fields.matching_version: Version of reproducible point/polygon matching policy.
fields.nearest_polygon_feature_id: Nearest raw polygon ID, for QA context only; does not establish identity or membership.
fields.nearest_polygon_distance_m: Point-centered WGS84 AEQD screening distance to a raw polygon, not surveyed accuracy.
fields.represented_feature_id: Parent polygon feature_id for a derived display symbol. Join to parent for selection/counts.
fields.counts_as_inventory: Always false for derived representative symbols; original inventory features counted separately.

limitations: Preliminary OSM-based inventory; source-tagged transmission is not official GI/GITET validation.
Not flagged in OSM does not establish existing or operational status.
Source data vintage is unknown; file modification time is not an OSM snapshot date.
Features are mapped segments/polygons, not unique circuits, corridors or verified stations.
Review candidates are unvalidated, separate from primary inventory and off by default.
Source points are matched against all polygons; only eligible distinct point-only candidates are published separately, off by default. Voltage/function/identity remain unverified.
No authoritative planned RUPTL/RUKN projects, region or power-system crosswalk was supplied.
COD, official circuit-km, MVA, capacity, thermal rating, AIS/GIS and verified HVDC are unavailable.
Cross-layer duplicates, electrical topology and registry completeness have not been validated.
